Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a handful of items we need to keep momentum:

1) Stakeholder mapping (please confirm names/roles):
   - Economic buyer / budget owner (we heard CFO but want the canonical owner)
   - Security review owner (security/infosec)
   - Legal contact for contracting
   - Procurement / AP vendor intake owner (PO & invoice flow)

2) Procurement specifics we need to support vendor onboarding:
   - Preferred vendor paperwork (W9 / COI / other)
   - Vendor portal URL or procurement ticketing process
   - Typical PO timing (30/45/60 days) and invoice cadence

3) Next steps we propose:
   - I’ll attach our standard onboarding packet (vendor docs + sample SOW).
   - Grace (CS lead) will join a short vendor-intake call with your procurement owner to speed the PO.
   - If legal needs an NDA/SLA tweak, we can send a lightweight redline first.

Could you confirm the procurement contact and whether ClearBank requires vendor TIN on the portal up front? Also, who should we send invoices to once we go live?

Attachments: redwood-vendor-onboarding-packet.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood-w9-and-tin.pdf (doc stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that speeds things up. Proposed times below if useful: Mon 6/14 10–11am ET, Tue 6/15 2–3pm ET.

Best,

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the follow-up and the packet. Below is the procurement/approval roster and some details to help you complete onboarding: 

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Ethan Ross (CFO) — will sign off on TCO and payment terms.
- Legal reviewer: Priya Shah (in-house counsel) — copied on legal threads once we reach contracting stage.
- Procurement / Vendor intake: Marcus D'Angelo (Procurement Manager) — he raises POs in our vendor portal.
- Security reviewer: Daniel Liu (Infosec) — runs the evidence collection (we use a short security checklist).

Procurement notes: 
- We require W9 (or equivalent), COI, and a completed vendor intake form to create you in our portal.
- Portal URL: https://vendors.clearbank.com/portal (you will need TIN and business address to complete).
- Standard payment: Net 45 from invoice receipt. Sometimes AP requests Net 60 for new vendors — that is possible but slower.
- For invoicing, send invoices to ap-invoices@clearbank.com and cc marcus.dangelo@clearbank.com.

Marcus is available for a vendor-intake call Tue 6/15 2pm ET or Wed 6/16 11am ET. Wed prefer a short call with Marcus + AP on the line so they can confirm the fields needed in the portal.

One question: Do you operate under a parent legal entity or multiple subsidiaries? We need the exact legal name and TIN that will appear on invoices.

Sophia Park
Senior Program Manager, Strategic Partnerships
